verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK with installation docs, a Google ADK extra, `init()` configuration (user_id, session_id, tags), `bento.track_ai` manual wrapping, and `bento.flush()` for short-lived processes, plus an OTel transport. It also supports SDK-level capture of LLM calls, so developers can build against it directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a first-party TypeScript/other-language SDK (TS is only implied via 'no Bento package at all'), a published API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.
